name: Deps Audit
description: 依赖漏洞扫描：唤起 osv-scanner 扫描工作区，列出 OSV 数据库中的依赖漏洞，让 Agent 给出升级或修复 patch。

en.name: Deps Audit
en.description: Dependency vulnerability audit: invoke osv-scanner over the workspace, list known OSV matches, and let the Agent propose a fix or upgrade.
en.safetyNotes: Reads only the workspace-root dependency manifests listed in the declared fs.read scope (package.json, lockfiles, requirements.txt, Cargo.toml/lock, go.mod/sum, pom.xml, composer.json/lock, Gemfile/lock, pyproject.toml) through the host fs gateway, stages sanitized copies in a throwaway temp directory, and spawns the local osv-scanner binary against that directory — the spawned binary never reads the workspace directly and contacts the OSV database over the network (declared High-risk capability). Staging copies are deleted after each scan. Nothing in the workspace is ever written.

changelog: 0.2.0：按维护者评审重做（#20）。修复插件生命周期（onLoad 改用宿主注入的 globalThis.pi，原实现因缺参而从不注册）；扫描面板改经宿主 API 解析当前工作区与设置（不再误扫插件进程目录）；清单文件改经 fs.read 权限网关读取，净化副本暂存一次性临时目录后再交给 osv-scanner（原生二进制与网络能力按 SECURITY.md 声明为 High 风险，附负面路径测试）；osv-scanner 命令改为 v2 正确用法（scan source --format json --recursive）；剪贴板复制改走宿主 clipboard.write 桥；PATH 查找兼容 Windows（where.exe）；面板符合 v3 chrome 契约。0.1.0：首个公开版本。
safetyNotes: 只经宿主 fs 网关读取声明作用域内的工作区根目录依赖清单（package.json、各语言锁文件等），把净化副本放入一次性临时目录，再对临时目录运行本机 osv-scanner 二进制——被拉起的二进制绝不直接读取工作区，且会联网访问 OSV 数据库（已声明 High 风险能力）。临时副本在每次扫描后删除；工作区永不被写入。

agentTools.name: deps_audit_run
agentTools.description: Run an OSV-Scanner audit on the workspace's dependency manifests. Returns a structured vulnerability list (ecosystem, package, installed version, fix versions, advisory links). The Agent must not auto-apply any fix — only summarize and propose; the user applies. Spawns the local osv-scanner binary, which contacts the OSV database over the network (High-risk capability).
